propositions: The DC backend transport must implement TicketTransport plus SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe roles using pycontribs/jira behind an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra, with lazy imports to preserve import rebar as dependency-free.
Transport auth uses PAT bearer tokens from JIRA_PAT env-only; URL and project come from typed config with fail-loud on ConfigError rather than graceful degradation.

Every transport method returns raw payload shapes (dicts with {key, fields}) that existing mappers consume, never jira.Issue objects, verified against the shared _jira_shape_contract held by both unit fakes and live tests.
Non-https URLs are rejected unless allow_insecure=true is set; certificate verification is never disabled (verify key is never False), and the ca_bundle config key supports internal CAs.
Retry policy mirrors acli_rest: transient faults (ConnectionError, Timeout, TimeoutError) are retried with 2s/5s backoff; HTTP errors are never retried.

Absence probe uses reconciler.resolved_statuses config (defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled}) to classify DC issues by workflow-specific resolved state names, avoiding misclassification as PRESENT_FILTERED.
